statuses.real: Taken directly from a published dataset.
statuses.derived: Calculated by this project from real data (e.g. density = population / polygon area).
statuses.estimate: Hand-entered representative value. Not computed from satellite imagery.
statuses.illustrative: Example records to demonstrate a feature. Not an official list.
statuses.summary: A shortened version of a longer official document.

Ward area.source: Geodesic area of each ward polygon
